description: Existing_Bike_Facilities is a dataset listed in Hawaii Department of Transportation open data portal (highways.hidot.hawaii.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Hawaii Department of Transportation. The O‘ahu Bike Plan guides the Honolulu Department of Transportation Service’s (DTS) bikeway planning for the entire island of O‘ahu and includes provisions to ensure that the proposed high capacity rail transit stations are integrated into the regional bikeway network. Coverage: Hawaii. The portal files it under the category Roadside Data. The table has 20 columns. The portal shows 2024-06-27 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-highways-hidot-hawaii-gov-portal.
